entries.name: Dollhand

counterPressure.note: The blade half of the build is deliberately modest (one Flat and one Increased attack line, both role-legal on armament-primary) — the reason to equip it is what happens the moment the wearer falls, not the swing before that. atom.martyrdom sits in the fixed core, which seed-contract.md §10 and ssot-uniques.md §3.7 device 2 both confirm is never pool-filtered, so its role legality is a bonus here, not a requirement.

entries.flavor: Six little fingers, each one sharpened after the last collector who wound it too far.
entries.notes: Role armament-primary / axis survivability, row 1 of the brief's 8-row table. baseType item.humanoid-main-hand-a-002 ('Slashing Clipper', class blade, band a) confirmed present in data/seed/items/base-types/humanoid-armament-primary-a.json. Name is naming.v1.json's 'fusion' pattern using uniqueSetSeedPools['gilded-porcelain']'s own atomic seed word 'Dollhand' (whole-token resolution, rule 2a — never decomposed). RUNTIME HONESTY: atom.martyrdom is resource.delta, one of the shipped kinds but lawn-live/battle-pending per the same caveat seed-contract.md §10's own unique example carries for atom.searing-strike — authored now, exactly as that worked example authorizes.

entries.name: Clockwork Sentinel

counterPressure.note: The raw side is one Increased-maxHp line plus a Flat-maxHp variance roll — a plain, unremarkable torso stat block. The whole reason to wear it is the jammed-mechanism proc, which no rare torso piece can roll at all.

entries.flavor: It has stood guard over the cabinet since before the family that built the cabinet stopped visiting.
entries.notes: Role core-guard / axis control, row 2. baseType item.humanoid-torso-b-004 ('Industrial Gridiron', class scale, band b) confirmed in humanoid-core-guard-b.json. Name is the 'compound' pattern: adjective 'Clockwork' from themeAdjectivePools['gilded-porcelain'], noun 'Sentinel' invented per naming.v1.json's allowance for a unique's own noun. atom.freezing (status.apply) is legal for armament-primary/secondary/manipulator/jewel-major/jewel-minor/sense per g-affliction.json, not core-guard — a deliberate fixed-core placement (bypasses pool filtering, ssot-uniques.md §3.7 device 2), read as a chest mechanism that jams whatever strikes it. The two raw-stat atoms (fortitude fixed, vitality variance) are both role-legal on core-guard and mutually distinct families, satisfying DuplicateAtomInContainer.

entries.name: Shelfwarden

counterPressure.note: The spawn-on-death rider only ever fires off the wearer's own killing blow (actorIsKiller, core.v1.json counterPressure.conditions), never off an ally's death nearby — a display piece that only ever helps once, and only at the one moment it can no longer help the wearer directly.

entries.flavor: It kept its post through the fall of three gardens, and counts that as a promotion.
entries.notes: Role ward-array / axis utility, row 3. baseType item.humanoid-shoulders-b-005 ('Articulated Yoke', class scale, band b) confirmed in humanoid-ward-array-b.json. Name is the 'fusion' pattern on uniqueSetSeedPools['gilded-porcelain']'s atomic seed 'Shelfwarden'. atom.gardener (spawn.entity, tag utility) has no ward-array in its g-on-death.json roles list — fixed core, not pool-filtered, same device as the other rule-broken capabilities in this file. The two raw armour atoms (arm-riveting fixed, arm-welding variance) are g-armour's zombie-side Increased siblings, both role-legal on ward-array and both distinct from atom.plating/atom.carapace's excluded Flat channel.

entries.name: Pricelesstoy

counterPressure.note: A single Increased-maxHp fixed line plus a wide-rolled Flat-maxHp variance slot is a thin defensive package for a neck slot at this rung — the currency-on-death payout is the entire pitch, and a build that does not need the extra money gets nothing else from it.

entries.flavor: Appraised twice, buried once, and dug back up the week the garden went quiet.
entries.notes: Role jewel-major / axis economy, row 4. baseType item.humanoid-neck-a-004 ('Official Locket', class seal, band a) confirmed in humanoid-jewel-major-a.json. Name is the 'fusion' pattern on uniqueSetSeedPools['gilded-porcelain']'s atomic seed 'Pricelesstoy' — deliberately chosen for the economy axis. atom.midas (resource.economy, currency money, OnDeath) and both raw-stat atoms are role-legal on jewel-major per their own roles lists (g-economy.json, g-life.json) — no fixed-core rule-break needed on this entry.

entries.name: Glazeface

counterPressure.note: The only self-sustain here is one Flat-hp line plus a normal-width Flat-maxHp roll, both a rung below what a cultivated rare would offer at this item level. Everything above that modest floor comes from the on-hit dark rider, which a rolled face piece cannot draw at all (atom.searing-strike is legal on sense per g-on-hit.json, but the elements+omni variant a unique fixes here is a single authored choice, not a pool draw).

entries.flavor: Its expression was painted on once, a century before it learned to change it.
entries.notes: Role sense / axis offense, row 5. baseType item.humanoid-face-b-004 ('Articulated Mask', class scale, band b) confirmed in humanoid-sense-b.json. Name is the 'fusion' pattern on uniqueSetSeedPools['gilded-porcelain']'s atomic seed 'Glazeface' — a direct fit for the face role. element 'dark' is one of the six concrete ids in core.v1.json elements (fire/ice/air/earth/light/dark) plus omni; gilded-porcelain carries no elementAffinity of its own so any concrete element is legal here. RUNTIME HONESTY: atom.searing-strike is resource.delta, lawn-live/battle-pending per the same caveat seed-contract.md §10's own unique example (unique.ember-014) carries for the identical family.

entries.name: Goldjoint

counterPressure.note: One Increased-maxHp fixed line and a narrow-rolled Flat-hp variance slot are both deliberately small — the shield grant on spawn is the actual survivability, and it is a one-time buffer rather than a recurring stat, so it cannot be stacked the way a rare's raw lines can.

entries.flavor: Every step still creaks in the key it was wound to, long after the winding stopped mattering.
entries.notes: Role footing / axis survivability, row 6. baseType item.humanoid-feet-b-004 ('Articulated Boot', class scale, band b) confirmed in footing/humanoid/b.json. Name is the 'fusion' pattern on uniqueSetSeedPools['gilded-porcelain']'s atomic seed 'Goldjoint' — a joint word fitting a feet-role item. atom.warded (shield.grant), atom.fortitude and atom.mending are all role-legal on footing per their own roles lists (g-sustain.json, g-life.json) — no fixed-core rule-break needed. atom.warded's channel is already implemented end to end per ShieldRuntime (shield-system-spec.md SS2.6), unlike the shield-stat family group, which stays fully avoided in this file.

entries.name: Cordial of the Kilnborn

counterPressure.note: The bandolier trades away part of its own arm1Max ceiling (severityBand moderate) to keep the vial cold enough to hold the hypno mixture stable — a real, authored cost on the same channel arm-riveting otherwise raises, not a free proc.

entries.flavor: Bottled from whatever the last harvest left too strange to plant.
entries.notes: Role infusion / axis control, row 7. baseType item.humanoid-bandolier-a-006 ('Treated Tin', class leather, band a) confirmed in infusion/humanoid/base-types-infusion-humanoid-a.json. Name is the 'of-construct' pattern: Base 'Cordial' (invented noun fitting a bandolier's vials) + concept 'Kilnborn' from uniqueSetSeedPools['gilded-porcelain'] (ofConcept surface form). atom.mesmerizing (status.apply) is legal for armament-primary/secondary/manipulator/jewel-major/jewel-minor/sense per g-affliction.json, not infusion — fixed core, not pool-filtered, per ssot-uniques.md §3.7 device 2. The two raw armour atoms are g-armour's role-legal zombie-side Increased siblings on infusion, distinct families, satisfying DuplicateAtomInContainer.

entries.name: Clarion of Poise

counterPressure.note: Every board effect this horn carries only ever resolves against a zombie-side target (sideIs, core.v1.json counterPressure.conditions) — on a humanoid-frame item that is most of what the wearer ever fights, but the one match where it is not, the horn is decorative and nothing more.

entries.flavor: It has never once sounded off-key, which is the part that unsettles the collection most.
entries.notes: Role retinue / axis utility, row 8. baseType item.humanoid-horn-b-009 ('Polished Horn', class torc, band b) confirmed in retinue/humanoid/b.json. Name is the 'of-construct' pattern: Base 'Clarion' (invented noun fitting a horn) + concept 'Poise' from conceptPools['gilded-porcelain']. All three atoms (atom.dooming, atom.terraforming, atom.gravedigging — board.action/box.set/grid.clear) are role-legal on retinue per g-board.json's own roles list, so no fixed-core rule-break is needed on this entry, and none of the three needs an element or other params override.
